name: cs-visionaries-book
description: Digital revolution backstage guide: computer science visionaries, trends, and modern technology history
author: ITDO JP Contributors

scripts.setup: node -e "console.error('Deprecated: npm run setup is disabled for this repository. Use README.md, QUICK-START.md, and REPOSITORY-ACCESS-GUIDE.md.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx http-server docs -p 8080 --silent
scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Deprecated: GitHub Pages deployment is handled by repository settings or workflows. Publish docs/ instead.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:light: npm run lint:light && npm run build
scripts.help:
echo 'Available commands:
  npm run build - Build the book
  npm run build:safe - Build with conflict detection
  npm run check-conflicts - Check Jekyll conflicts
  npm run fix-conflicts - Auto-fix Jekyll conflicts
  npm run preview - Local preview (docs/)
  npm run configure:workflows - Disable problematic workflows
  npm run deploy - Deprecated: deployment is handled outside package.json'
